The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 77e967a1db5965db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 4-5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: For every game in the input class, there are vectors G, ψ ∈ RV and a pure positional strategy pair (σ∗, τ∗) whose selected edges attain the extrema defining fu(v(u)) for every 0 < u ≤ 1/(2H). Moreover, vi(u) = Gi + uψi + O(u2 ) (u ↓ 0). (2.4) For every start vertex i and every behavioral opposing strategy, Ei,σ∗,τ [MPw] ≥ Gi, Ei,σ,τ∗ [MPw] ≤ Gi. (2.5) 4 Consequently Gi = val(i). Each Gi is rational with a representation whose denominator has absolute value at most A0, and |Gi| ≤ W, Gi ̸= 0 =⇒ |Gi| ≥ 1 H , |vi(λ0) − Gi| ≤ 1 16H . (2.6)
